payload.description: An overhead satellite frame displaying a prominent ground facility surrounded by dense urban development. The central portion of the facility features a large circular driveway and pad system arranged in a symmetrical radial pattern around a central line and pad. To the south of this circular structure, there are several rectangular buildings, paved assembly or parking aprons holding rows of small objects/vehicles, and connecting access roads. The surrounding area consists of city blocks with high-rise and mid-rise residential structures, paved roadways, and ongoing construction sites.

features.note: Symmetrical circular pad and loop pattern in the center of the open ground area
Several structures located south of the circular section
Paved aprons with small parked objects south of the circular layout
Internal access tracks and surrounding city street grid

payload.gsd_note: Sub-meter overhead imagery clearly depicting facility layout and surrounding urban context.
